This Lease Agreement made the 2025-12-3 , by and between Mrs. Patti Fay MD [name of lessor], of S1323 Unique Village [street address], State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Wetmarohnc [name of lessee], of BA7B4 Godfrey Grove [stret adres], Ste of California , hereinafter rerred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:

1543 The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described square feet (SF) of Warchouse located at 52577 Hailey Corners [street address], State of California.

2. TERM OF LEASE:

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of4 year(s) 2

month(s) commencing on the 31 day of December 2025 day of Deccmber 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 3 day of

March 2030 day of March 2030 ("Initial Term")

3. BASE RENT:

2317

The net monthly payment shall be 9750 dollars ($9750) per month. A security deposit of dollars($2317) is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month

4. Options to Renew (Check one):

- Lessee may not renew the Lease.

- [ ] The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of renewal period(s) with each term being year(s) month(s) which may be exercised bygiving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
